entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Aulus Cremutius Cordus was a Roman historian. There are very few remaining fragments of his work, principally covering the civil war and the reign of Augustus. In AD 25 he was forced by Sejanus, who was praetorian prefect under Tiberius, to take his life after being accused of violating the lex maiestas.
